newsitem.title: ESTONIA: METAL EXPORT CO. GOES INTO NEXT STAGE OF SALE.
newsitem.headline: METAL EXPORT CO. GOES INTO NEXT STAGE OF SALE.

text.p: The Estonian privatisation agency said on Tuesday that it will select companies on Wednesday for further negotiations for the purchase of 51 percent of the Estonian Metal export company.
"On Wednesday the board will decide with whom they will continue negotiations and who will be invited to present final bids," an official of the agency said to Reuters.
The first round of negotiated bids closed on May 8 and six companies were selected.
The six companies were: HKS GmbH Handelsegellschaft, Neotrust OU, Amalard As, Transkorp OU, Nelimet As, and Kuusakoski OY.
The privatisation agency said that interest in a 51 percent stake in the metal export company has remained high.
